description: Implement the AWS CDK infrastructure stacks, DPI integration services, Open API specifications, and comprehensive Playwright E2E tests. This feature completes the platform with production infrastructure definitions, government system integrations, API documentation, and browser-based testing.
steps: Create infrastructure/lib/stacks/auth-stack.ts - AWS CDK stack for Cognito User Pool with custom attributes for tenant/role, MFA config, Lambda triggers for custom auth flows, identity pool for federated access

Create infrastructure/lib/stacks/database-stack.ts - DynamoDB tables with single-table design: main table with GSIs for access patterns, TTL for sessions, point-in-time recovery, auto-scaling config. Optional Aurora Serverless v2 for analytics queries
Create infrastructure/lib/stacks/api-stack.ts - API Gateway HTTP API with Lambda integrations, custom domain mapping per tenant (*.platform.gov.in), WAF rules, throttling per tenant
Create infrastructure/lib/stacks/storage-stack.ts - S3 buckets for content (with CloudFront CDN), user uploads, data lake. Lifecycle policies, encryption at rest, CORS config
Create infrastructure/lib/stacks/ai-stack.ts - AI infrastructure: SageMaker endpoints for custom models, Bedrock access config, Lambda layers for AI dependencies
Create infrastructure/lib/stacks/messaging-stack.ts - SQS queues for async processing (content generation, analytics, notifications), SNS topics for events, DLQ configuration
Create infrastructure/lib/stacks/monitoring-stack.ts - CloudWatch dashboards, alarms for error rates and latency, X-Ray tracing config, log groups with retention policies
Create infrastructure/lib/stacks/network-stack.ts - VPC for Aurora and private resources, NAT gateways, security groups, VPC endpoints for AWS services
Create infrastructure/bin/app.ts - CDK app entry point composing all stacks with environment-specific configuration (dev, staging, prod)
Create packages/shared/src/dpi/apaar.ts - APAAR integration service: student ID verification, profile fetch, enrollment updates via APAAR APIs
Create packages/shared/src/dpi/digilocker.ts - DigiLocker integration: OAuth2 flow, document pull/push, certificate issuance verification
Create packages/shared/src/dpi/abc.ts - Academic Bank of Credits integration: credit deposit/withdrawal, transfer between institutions, transcript generation
Create packages/shared/src/dpi/consent-manager.ts - DPDP-compliant consent manager: granular consent collection, purpose limitation, data minimization, right to erasure implementation
Create packages/shared/src/dpi/data-governance.ts - Data governance utilities: data classification, retention policies, audit logging, data subject access request (DSAR) handling
Create apps/api/src/handlers/dpi/apaar.ts - Lambda handlers for APAAR integration endpoints
Create apps/api/src/handlers/dpi/digilocker.ts - Lambda handlers for DigiLocker integration
Create apps/api/src/handlers/dpi/abc.ts - Lambda handlers for Academic Bank of Credits
Create docs/api/openapi.yaml - Complete OpenAPI 3.0 specification for all platform APIs: auth, tenants, learning, assessment, AI, DPI integrations, governance

Create docs/ARCHITECTURE.md - Comprehensive architecture document: system context diagram (C4), container diagram, component diagrams, data flow diagrams, security architecture, multi-tenancy model, AI pipeline architecture
Create docs/DPI-COMPLIANCE.md - DPI compliance documentation: APAAR integration spec, DigiLocker flows, ABC protocols, DPDP compliance matrix, data governance policies
Create docs/DEPLOYMENT.md - Deployment guide: AWS account setup, CDK deployment steps, environment configuration, DNS setup for multi-tenant subdomains, monitoring setup
Create tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts - Playwright E2E tests for authentication flow: login, registration, MFA, password reset, tenant switching
Create tests/e2e/student-journey.spec.ts - Playwright E2E tests for student experience: login, view dashboard, start AI tutor session, take assessment, view results
Create tests/e2e/teacher-journey.spec.ts - Playwright E2E tests for teacher experience: login, view class analytics, create content with AI, assign assessment, grade submissions
Create tests/e2e/admin-journey.spec.ts - Playwright E2E tests for admin experience: login, manage users, configure tenant, view analytics
Create tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts - Playwright accessibility tests: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance checks across all major pages, keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility
Create tests/e2e/fixtures/test-data.ts - Shared test fixtures: mock tenant data, user profiles, learning content for E2E tests
Create tests/e2e/helpers/auth-helper.ts - E2E test helpers for authentication state management, tenant context setup
acceptance_criteria: AWS CDK app synthesizes all stacks without errors (cdk synth)
Infrastructure stacks define all required AWS resources with proper security configurations
DPI integration services have proper TypeScript types and error handling
OpenAPI specification covers all platform endpoints with request/response schemas
Playwright test files are syntactically correct and properly structured
Architecture documentation covers all system components and their interactions
DPDP compliance is documented with specific implementation details
All TypeScript files across the project compile without errors
